## Wheels & Boards Sports

## Wheels & Boards Sports

## BMX & Mountain Biking Resources

  * The [BMX Biking Program](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/BMX_BIKING_PROGRAM-1.pdf) provides guidance for local councils that wish to operate a BMX biking program in the future or improving existing program,
  * The [BMX Design Reference Guide](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/BMX_DESIGN_REFERENCE_GUIDE.pdf) is a design reference guideline intended to describe the different types of program activities in practice within the industry and to provide guidance to the council on aspects of a successful program that should be considered as they relate to scope, cost, resources, effort and safe design.
  * The [Mountain Biking Program Guide](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/MOUNTAIN_BIKING_PROGRAM_GUIDE.pdf) provides the recommended minimum standards that all BSA council operated mountain bike programs should maintain.
  * The [Mountain Biking Design Guideline](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/MOUNTAIN_BIKING_DESIGN_GUIDELINE.pdf) provides general guidance in the layout and design of mountain biking trails and facilities in BSA Council camps.
  * [Mountain Bike Safety Checklist ](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/3230624-Mtn-Bike-Poster_FPO1.pdf)(ABCD Checklist Card)

## Cycling Resources

  * [Scouting Magazine article](https://scoutingmagazine.org/2015/02/run-bike-rodeo-cub-scouts/) about how to organize a bike rodeo for you Cub Scout pack

## Skateboarding Resources

  * USA Skateboarding has created a series of resource videos in support of the Scouts BSA Skating Merit Badge. Links to these videos can be found on the [Skating Merit Badge webpage](https://www.scouting.org/merit-badges/skating/).
